jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Experience Above the Box (all genders)
jobs.description:
About tonies:

tonies is the globally leading interactive audio platform for children with more than 10 million Tonieboxes and 125 million Tonies sold. The intuitive and award-winning audio system has changed the way young children play and learn independently with its child-safe, wireless, and screen-free approach. Tonieboxes have been activated in over 100 countries, the content portfolio includes around 1,400 Tonies in several languages. Since its inception, tonies has achieved significant milestones, including listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in November 2021 as well as a globally present team of over 550 dedicated professionals operating from various countries.

Joining our tonies team means being part of an inspiring mission to create innovative and meaningful experiences for children around the world. Together, we’re shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.


You as part of tonies:

Above the box is where the magic of tonies becomes tangible: the Tonies themselves — Content, Creative, Clever — and Tonieplay. As Engineering Manager (all genders) for our Above-the-Box value stream, you lead a cross-functional team that owns these experiences end to end — from the device through App and cloud, across every Toniebox generation and every device our products will run on next.

The team is newly formed and set to grow, with a mix of internal and external engineers. Together with your Product Manager, you shape both the experiences we ship and the team that builds them, bringing joy to millions of children worldwide. Ready to help us create the future of audio play?


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

  • Team Leadership: You nurture the professional growth of your engineers and build a culture where inclusive mentorship, continuous learning, and high collaboration are the norm — across disciplines, and across internal and external team members alike.
  • Building & Scaling the Team: You grow the team as our roadmap grows: shaping the profiles we hire, onboarding and integrating external engineers, and making sure critical knowledge stays with the team rather than walking out the door.
  • End-to-End Ownership: You make your team genuinely accountable for its experiences — embedded, app, and cloud — rather than handing work over at team boundaries.
  • Architectural Oversight: You oversee the structural integrity of the Above-the-Box implementations, ensuring a consistent user experience across multiple device generations through clean abstractions and cross-functional end-to-end ownership.
  • Interfaces & Dependencies: You define the application-level APIs your team needs from our platform teams and turn cross-team dependencies into clear, testable contracts instead of coordination overhead.
  • Product Sync & Strategy: You synchronise with Product Management to prioritise features and technical debt, ensuring that every engineering cycle directly fuels the overarching tonies® product vision.
  • Leading Through Change: You bring the team through transitions with a clear vision, identifying what needs to improve and driving those improvements together with your engineers.
  • Technical Credibility & Hands-on Depth: You stay close enough to the code to run high-impact reviews, challenge architectural decisions, and step in on critical problems — so our quality standards remain uncompromised, including for work delivered by external partners.
  • Delivery Excellence: You manage the end-to-end delivery process, applying lean principles to streamline workflows and ensure stable, plannable, reliable releases for our customers.
Your Team's Responsibilities

  • Designing, building, and maintaining the Above-the-Box experience — our value stream covering everything our users experience beyond the box itself:

    • Content-, Creative- and Clever Tonies

    • Tonieplay

  • Delivering these experiences across the full stack, from on-device software through app and cloud services

  • Specifying the abstract interfaces (APIs) delivered by our lower-level platform teams, so the team can own its experiences end to end across hardware generations

  • Safeguarding quality through end-to-end ownership and test automation owned inside the team

  • Partnering closely with Product Management to translate the experience roadmap into sustainable delivery

  • Acting as the point of contact for Above-the-Box topics across the wider engineering organisation


What we are looking for:

  • Leadership & Team Empowerment: You have experience leading engineering teams—including specialists outside your own discipline—and excel at turning complex challenges into a clear vision. You seamlessly integrate external engineers and partners to build one unified team grounded in shared standards, collective ownership, and zero second-class contributors.

  • Technical Acumen & Hands-on Depth: You bring a long-standing background as a software engineer with genuine full-stack breadth — you have depth in embedded, backend, or mobile development, and enough working knowledge of the others to reason about, review, and challenge decisions across the whole stack. While your focus is on leadership and design, you can still dive into the codebase to unblock critical bottlenecks.

  • Architectural Vision: You advocate for modular, flexibly extendable, loosely coupled architectures with strong cohesion — so a feature can be built once and shipped across several hardware generations without being rewritten each time.

  • Strategic Product Alignment: You act as the bridge between engineering and product strategy. You translate business goals into technical reality and collaborate seamlessly across departments to keep our roadmap both ambitious and achievable.

  • The Toolbox: Solid experience with software platforms and their architecture. Linux is your home ground, and Git, GitLab, and CI/CD are part of your daily workflow. Experience working with ODMs or hardware suppliers is a strong plus.

  • Clean Design & Simplicity: You champion lean structures and have a knack for solving complex problems with simple, elegant solutions — in code and in organisational processes alike.

  • Work Style: Your approach is defined by agility, empathy, and creativity, especially when exploring new solutions or navigating change.

  • Communication & Collaboration: You communicate confidently in professional English (German is a plus) and enjoy being with your team in the office regularly.

  • Last but not least: You are enthusiastic about our product and want to join us on our exciting journey!


Why tonies?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders on our vision to bring the Toniebox into every child's room in the world.

  • Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code but also to everything else. Because only where you truly feel comfortable can you give your best.

  • Mobility: Choose the option that suits you best – a Deutschlandticket (public transport ticket) for unlimited mobility, a monthly contribution for an office parking space, a leasing bicycle, or a remote work subsidy.

  • Enhanced Security: Benefit from subsidies for company pension plans, occupational pension schemes, and occupational disability insurance.

  • Rest & Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of paid annual leave plus three additional days off such as Rosenmontag, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve. After one year of employment, you can also use up to 10 "toniecation days" (unpaid leave days).

  • Continuous Learning: Benefit from our internal and external training opportunities as well as an individual learning budget to continuously expand your knowledge.

  • Language Learning & Relaxation: Improve your communication skills with the language learning app Babbel and find relaxation through our access to the meditation app Calm.

  • Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire range of tonies products.


Good to know:

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Sabine Schykowski
Talent Acquisition Manager

jobs.title: Trainee People & Culture / HR (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
#keepquestioning

Du begeisterst dich für Human Resources und möchtest People-Themen und die Unternehmenskultur in einem mittelständischen Medien- und Weiterbildungsunternehmen mit ca. 150 Mitarbeitenden aktiv mitgestalten? Du willst als Teil unseres 3-köpfigen People & Culture-Teams Prozesse smarter machen, Mitarbeitende entlang ihres gesamten Employee Life Cycles begleiten und dabei Schritt für Schritt in die Rolle hineinwachsen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung als Trainee People & Culture / HR (m/w/d).


Deine Verantwortung

  • Du unterstützt als Ansprechperson unsere Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Employee Life Cycles (Onboarding bis Offboarding) und übernimmst hier zunehmend eigene Themen und deinen eigenen Mitarbeitendenstamm.
  • Du lernst alle relevanten HR-Prozesse kennen, hilfst mit, sie zu optimieren, und bringst eigene Ideen zum Einsatz von KI-Tools ein.
  • Du betreust eigene Stellen im Recruiting-Prozess – von der Erstellung der Stellenausschreibung bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag – und trägst so zu einer positiven Candidate Experience bei. Dabei entwickelst du gemeinsam mit dem Team kreative Wege, um passende Kandidat:innen zu gewinnen - auch per Active Sourcing.
  • Du unterstützt bei der internen Unternehmenskommunikation und der Organisation interner Veranstaltungen, hilfst mit, P&C-Themen sichtbar zu machen, und bringst eigene Impulse für die Unternehmenskultur ein.


Deine Skills

  • Du hast dein Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich (z. B. Wirtschafts-, Sozial- oder Geisteswissenschaften mit HR-Bezug) abgeschlossen - oder dein Abschluss steht unmittelbar bevor.
  • Du bringst mindestens ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit im Bereich HR, People & Culture oder Personalverwaltung mit.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Ausdrucksstärke aus und hast große Freude am Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und Kolleg:innen.
  • Du bringst einen starken Teamgeist, Neugier und Lust mit, Prozesse mit- und neuzugestalten - idealerweise bist du außerdem affin für digitale Tools und hast erste Erfahrungen mit KI-Anwendungen.
  • Du legst eine strukturierte, organisierte Arbeitsweise, ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten und ein lösungsorientiertes Mindset an den Tag.
  • Du bringst idealerweise Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht mit und bist motiviert, dein Wissen hier kontinuierlich auszubauen und auf dem neuesten Stand zu halten.
  • Du verfügst über exzellente Deutsch- und mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse.

Erzähl uns, wer du bist.
Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und dein frühestes Startdatum. Nicht alle oben genannten Punkte treffen auf dich zu, du kannst dir jedoch vorstellen, mit deinen Skills und deiner Persönlichkeit unser Team zu bereichern? 
Bewirb dich gern - wir sind immer auf der Suche nach motivierten Talenten. Wir melden uns schnellstmöglich bei dir zurück. Bitte teile uns mit, sofern du eine geschlechtsneutrale Ansprache wünschst.

Unsere Rahmenbedingungen für dich als Trainee:
  • Dauer: Die Dauer des Traineeships umfasst 18 Monate.
  • Umfang: Du unterstützt uns mit 40 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Vergütung: Zusätzlich zu einer fairen Vergütung bekommst du von uns ein BVG-Ticket und wir ermöglichen dir deine gezielte Weiterbildung im Bereich People Management / People & Culture / HR.


Unsere Benefits

  • Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell: Gestalte deinen Arbeitsbeginn, deine Pause und deinen Feierabend flexibel um unsere Kernarbeitszeit von 10-15 Uhr. 
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Nutze die Möglichkeit, bis zu 2 Tage pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten.  
  • Urlaub, Flexity Tage und Workation: Erhole dich an 30 bezahlten Urlaubstagen im Kalenderjahr bei einer 5-Tage-Woche. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, 10 unbezahlte Urlaubstage zu nutzen. Mit unserem Workation-Modell kannst du außerdem bis zu 2 Wochen im Jahr innerhalb der EU aus dem Ausland arbeiten. 
  • Weiterbildungen: Ganz nach unserem Motto #keepquestioning fördern wir dich in deiner Rolle mit 5 Weiterbildungstagen im Jahr. Wir möchten dich in deiner beruflichen Entwicklung dabei unterstützen, deine Skills auszubauen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern. 
  • Teamatmosphäre: Sei Teil eines motivierten, herzlichen Teams aus über 150 Mitarbeitenden und erlebe regelmäßige Afterworks, Teamevents und gemeinsame Unternehmungen. 
  • Chancengleichheit: Eine offene, tolerante und herzliche Umgebung und gleiche Chancen für alle Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen - unabhängig vom Geschlecht, Aussehen, Alter, ethnischem Hintergrund und Religion. 
  • Kurze Wege und flache Hierarchien: Erlebe bei uns eine Arbeitsatmosphäre auf Augenhöhe, kurze Kommunikationswege und Duz-Kultur. 
  • Mitwirken und Teilnahme an Fachtagungen und Kongressen: Erweitere dein Wissen und Netzwerk durch dein Mitwirken und die Teilnahme an unseren renommierten Veranstaltungen, wie zum Beispiel dem Personalmanagementkongress, dem Kommunikationskongress oder der KI-X. 
  • Internes Sportprogramm und Kooperation mit Urban Sports Club: Nutze unsere vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club und bleibe aktiv mit unserem vielfältigen internen Sportangebot (z.B. Yoga, Beach-Volleyball und Teilnahme an Firmenläufen). 
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Sorge für deine Zukunft vor mit der Möglichkeit der Bezuschussung einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. 
  • Fühl dich wohl und sei du selbst: Bei uns zählt der Mensch, nicht das Outfit. Komm so, wie du dich wohlfühlst.  
  • Lage im Herzen Berlins mit sehr guter ÖPNV-Anbindung: Erreiche uns bequem mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und genieße die pulsierende Atmosphäre der Hauptstadt. 
  • Modernes begrüntes Office mit Innenhof: Arbeite in einem inspirierenden Umfeld mit viel Tageslicht, einer Vielfalt an Pflanzen im Office und in unserem sonnigen Innenhof sowie einem Angebot an frischem Obst, Getränken und Snacks. 

Bitte beachte:
Wir benutzen im Recruiting-Prozess punktuell unterstützend KI. Dabei halten wir uns selbstverständlich an den geltenden Rahmen des EU-AI Acts - die entscheidende Instanz ist immer ein Mensch und keine KI.

jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence.

In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes.

Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals

  • Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews

  • Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander)

  • Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment

  • Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions

  • Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update

Interface & System Specifications

  • Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering

  • Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients

  • Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences

  • Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version

  • Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines

Operational & Field Documentation

  • Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides

  • Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems

  • Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises

  • Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions

Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management

  • Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication

  • Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes

  • Coordinate review cycles with Engineering, Product, and Pre & Post Sales teams — ensuring technical accuracy before publication

  • Manage the documentation repository in Notion and ensure all documents are findable, versioned, and access-controlled appropriately

  • Track and incorporate feedback from field deployments, client reviews, and post-sales observations into documentation updates

Client-Facing Delivery Documentation

  • Produce documentation packages for client deliverables: acceptance test procedures, delivery dossiers, and contractual documentation requirements

  • Support the preparation of responses to RFP documentation requirements and compliance matrices

  • Contribute to the development of training packages for institutional clients and partner integrators

  • Ensure client-facing documentation meets applicable defence documentation standards and contractual specifications

Candidate Profile - Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical writing — with a strong focus on product documentation, user manuals, or operational guides

  • Prior experience documenting hardware-software integrated systems — mandatory : you must be comfortable with complex, multi-component products

  • Background in defence, aerospace, robotics, deeptech, or dual-use is a strong plus — you understand the operational context in which your documentation will be used

  • Experience producing documentation for non-specialist end-users (operators, field technicians) as well as technical audiences (engineers, integrators)

  • Prior exposure to documentation lifecycle management and versioning in a product environment

jobs.title: Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer – Interceptor Drones
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

About the Role
We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and iteration matter more than lengthy upfront studies.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost

  • Own the aerodynamic design of turbine components, balancing performance, manufacturability, and cost

  • Design a large portion of the turbine for metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing), leveraging design-for-AM principles to reduce part count, weight, and cost

  • Work closely with 3D printing operations to define printable geometries, tolerances, post-processing, and qualify parts for flight use

  • Drive a rapid, fail-fast iteration process: build, test, learn, and redesign quickly rather than relying on long analytical phases before prototyping

  • Integrate propulsion systems into airframes such as flying wings and other interceptor drone configurations, working with aerostructures and systems teams

  • Apply and enforce design rules for operation in extreme environments (cold and hot climates, rain, humidity, icing conditions) to ensure engine reliability across the full operational envelope

  • Contribute to engine testing (bench and flight), performance validation, and continuous design improvement

Candidate Profile:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in jet engine / gas turbine design, with a proven track record of having designed and delivered engine models (not just component-level work)

  • Strong hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class

  • Solid global understanding of jet engine architecture: compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions

  • Experience designing turbine/engine components for metal additive manufacturing (DfAM), and practical knowledge of metal 3D printing processes and constraints

  • Comfortable working in a rapid-iteration, fail-fast development culture rather than a traditional long-cycle aerospace process

  • Experience integrating propulsion systems into airframes (flying wing or similar unconventional platforms is a strong plus)

  • Knowledge of design requirements for extreme operating environments (temperature extremes, precipitation, icing)

  • Ability to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced startup team, wearing multiple hats when needed

Nice to Have

jobs.title: Account Manager – Retention Specialist
jobs.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte

Les cabinets d’avocats indépendants représentent le segment qui connaît la plus forte croissance chez Doctrine, avec une hausse de 50 % sur les 12 derniers mois.

Pour accompagner cette dynamique, tu joueras un rôle clé dans la fidélisation de nos clients et le développement de ton portefeuille. 

Nous recherchons un·e Account Manager (Retention Specialist) pour rejoindre notre équipe dédiée aux avocats indépendants.

Tu seras responsable d’un portefeuille de plus de 800 clients, avec une priorité : leur donner envie de rester chez Doctrine. Cela passe par des échanges réguliers, des démonstrations utiles à leur pratique et des négociations pour renouveler leur abonnement.

Tu travailleras avec les Sales Specialists, qui prennent en charge les ventes de produits complémentaires à partir des besoins que tu identifies chez tes clients.

Ce poste associe relation client, expertise produit et négociation commerciale, avec un impact direct sur la rétention et la croissance des revenus.


Les missions :
  • Contacter les clients qui utilisent peu nos solutions ou rencontrent des difficultés, pour comprendre ce qui bloque et les aider à reprendre leur utilisation.

  • Traiter les demandes de résiliation: comprendre les raisons du départ, répondre aux objections, démontrer la réelles valeur de doctrine  et définir une nouvelle proposition contractuelle pour ré-engager le client.

  • Anticiper les renouvellements d’abonnement et assurer le suivi des engagements pris avec les clients.

  • Réaliser des démonstrations et former les clients à nos solutions.

  • Identifier les opportunités business cross-sell et les transmettre aux Sales Specialists..

  • Organiser le suivi de ton portefeuille dans le CRM et suivre tes résultats : revenu conservé, renouvellements et clients réactivés.

  • Remonter les retours clients aux équipes Produit et Support, et partager avec l’équipe les approches qui fonctionnent.


    • À propos de toi :

  • Tu as une première expérience en vente ou en gestion de comptes B2B, avec des objectifs commerciaux.

  • Tu aimes convaincre et négocier. Tu sais écouter une insatisfaction, répondre aux objections et chercher un accord.

  • Tu es à l’aise au téléphone et prends volontiers l’initiative d’appeler tes clients.

  • Tu sais gérer un portefeuille conséquent, choisir tes priorités et tenir tes engagements.

  • Tu es curieux·se, tu apprends rapidement et tu sais expliquer simplement le fonctionnement d’un produit.

  • Tu apprécies les retours pour progresser et tu partages tes conseils avec tes collègues.

  • Tu t’exprimes clairement à l’oral comme à l’écrit, en français. Une formation ou une expérience juridique est un plus, mais n’est pas un prérequis.


    • Pourquoi être AM/Growth Retention chez Doctrine ?

  • Occuper un poste qui associe négociation commerciale, relation client et expertise produit, auprès d’avocats indépendants.

  • Être responsable d’un portefeuille de clients significatif avec pour objectif de les fidéliser et de développer ce portefeuille. NRR

  • Vendre et accompagner l’utilisation de solutions d’IA juridique qui évoluent régulièrement.

  • Bénéficier d’un onboarding complet, de formations et d’un accompagnement régulier pour progresser.

  • S’appuyer sur les équipes Ops et Marketing dans ton travail quotidien.

  • Bénéficier d’un package attractif avec un variable déplafonné.

  • Rejoindre une équipe qui se retrouve aussi lors de conférences, déjeuners, team-buildings et offsites.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.

jobs.description:
About us

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Salary range:
£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback.  If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy. 

Reasonable adjustments and support

If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email

jobs.title: Delivery Manager Genflex
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in English. A second European language would be preferable.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA )

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

jobs.title: Field Event Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Field Event Manager based in London to build our presence across EMEA.

About the Role

Exa is expanding to the EU and the UK and we are looking for an ambitious, proactive, and collaborative Field Marketer to partner closely with our regional team and build demand in this critical market. Companies big and small are making critical decisions about how to invest in AI and how their AI agents will retrieve information, and you will play a key role in how they discover Exa. As the first Field Marketer in EMEA, you will shape how buyers experience our brand and interact with our team, through highly strategic, and thoughtfully crafted events.

This is one of those rare, founding team member opportunities: you'll build the regional program from the ground up and inform so much beyond our event strategy; from messaging and overall brand presence at a pivotal time for Exa. This is an incredible fit for someone who sweats the details, lives to create world-class experiences, and obsesses over how to drive pipeline from every touchpoint. You will own the regional program, identify opportunities to build brand awareness and pipeline through a mix of high-hospitality and lead generating events including: executive dinners, networking receptions, hackathons, third-party sponsorships, partner events, and more. You'll partner strategically with Account Executives and SDRs to build an event plan that delivers coverage across your territory and key accounts.

Our bar is high and our north star is to establish Exa as a world-class brand. We’re a team that embraces learnings as opportunities to optimize future events and processes, while remaining focused on our pursuit to drive ever increasing pipeline. If this sounds exciting to you, we'd love to meet you!

This role is based in person in London, with regular travel across the EMEA and the occasional trip to our San Francisco HQ.

What You Will Own

Regional program strategy. Own the plan for your territory, deciding which formats, cities, audiences, and investments will meet our pipeline goals each quarter. Co-build the plan with input from sales and defend it with pipeline rationale. Success is measured by program quality and by pipeline sourced and influenced in the region.

End-to-end execution. Own every event from concept to post-event follow-up: sourcing venues, orchestrating vendors and production, managing invitations and the run of show, overseeing on-site execution, and sweating every detail. Success is measured by the number of qualified attendees and by nailing execution.

Sales partnership and account targeting alignment. Establish and maintain tight sales partnerships, align with sales to get the right personas and accounts to each event and create effective event playbooks that convert to pipeline. Success is measured by meetings generated and by the number of target accounts engaged through your programs.

Pipeline outcomes and follow-through. Own what happens during and after the event: ensuring timely lead handoff and building the follow-up sequence in partnership with SDRs, Lifecycle Marketing, and Marketing Ops. Success is measured by conversion from attendee to qualified opportunity.

Budget and vendors. Own your regional budget, vendor selection and negotiation, and cost per qualified lead. Success is measured by program impact per dollar.

AI-first operations. Use AI to compress operational timelines: invite-list development, personalized outreach at scale, vendor research, run-of-show generation, and post-event summarization. You'll run a serious regional program because the busywork is automated.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of experience in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company, including ownership of a regional program rather than execution of someone else's.

  • Deeply committed to event craft: You can walk us through a run of show, tell us what you check at 4pm before a 6pm start, and describe the last thing that went wrong at an event and how you fixed it.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive pipeline: You have owned a pipeline number and can speak to cost per qualified lead.

  • Evidence of strong sales partnership: You can speak to how you've built strong partnerships with sales counterparts in similar roles, including how you manage reps who push for something you know isn't the right investment.

  • Deep understanding of the EMEA market: You have a finger on the pulse of the cultural nuances, best venues, vendors, and event tactics that will draw an audience of senior technical buyers here.

  • Meticulous event budget and timeline management: You have both budget and vendor negotiation experience.

  • Upholds a growth mindset: You embrace feedback as a lever to fuel growth and see learnings as an opportunity to optimize for next time.

  • Experience using AI to drive efficiencies: You use AI daily to remove operational load, and can show us how.

Nice to Have

  • Experience running events for a technical or developer audience alongside enterprise buyers.

  • Experience at an early-stage company where you built the program rather than inherited it.

  • Experience developing booth designs and strategies that drive lead generation.

  • Familiarity with event tech (registration, badge scanning, on-site capture) and how it connects to CRM.

  • Experience crafting executive roundtables or advisory dinners for senior technical leaders.

  • Experience building reports to track event performance.

Benefits

  • Health and wellness: Premium medical coverage, plus a monthly wellness benefit tiered by location.

  • Fertility and family planning: Reimbursement for eligible egg freezing and related medical expenses up to a $15,000 lifetime maximum, plus 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, whether through birth, adoption, surrogacy, or foster placement.

  • Life at Exa: Our SF office serves lunch and dinner daily, with snacks, coffee, fresh bread from a local bakery, weekly milk tea, monthly picnics, and parties to celebrate the wins (and each other). You'll visit often.

  • Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and locations.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate, enthusiastic, and looking for an opportunity to grow your career in sales? Are you looking for your next challenge in an emerging and exciting market? If yes then we want to hear from you!

The impact you will have:

You will join our EMEA Commercial team, part of Elliptic's global Commercial organisation, and champion uncovering and developing new customer relationships across EMEA. As an Inside Sales Representative you will become an expert in Elliptic's value proposition, helping both prospective and existing customers navigate and enter the digital asset market with your knowledge of our product and of the compliance and regulatory environment.

You will own the full sales cycle for new business in the Growth segment, and you will grow the customers already in your patch in two ways: up-sell, expanding what an existing customer already buys as their usage and licence needs grow, and cross-sell, introducing Elliptic products they do not yet use. You will manage the full cycle including prospecting, qualifying, developing proposals, negotiating terms and closing.

This is an opportunity to build a career in a market you can shape as well as sell into. Fascinating and challenging work is the norm - working at Elliptic is never boring!

What you will do:

  • Run the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest.

  • Develop net new business and cross sell opportunities across the Growth segment within EMEA

  • Build out strategic market penetration plan, prospect, and manage full sales cycle

  • Use AI tooling to work a patch of 1,000+ Growth accounts at scale: researching and segmenting accounts, building and iterating outbound motions, and drafting personalised outreach at volume without losing quality.

  • Proactively contact prospects to identify & qualify sales opportunities.

  • Prospect and generate high quality leads

  • Develop custom proposals based on customer requirements

  • Conduct presentations and product demos

  • Negotiate terms and close the business

  • Work with Customer Success to review licence utilisation and product adoption across the accounts in your patch, using that data to identify and run up-sell and cross-sell plays, with ownership agreed per account with the CSM.

  • Be an ambassador of the Elliptic brand, living our values of curiosity, trust, and action in every interaction.

  • Confident, consultative, and persuasive, able to build strong stakeholder relationships at all levels, from mid-level managers to C-suites.

  • A collaborative team player, independent yet never a “lone wolf.” You value and engage support from your pack.

  • Agile, resourceful, and fearless, you see opportunities where others see blockers and know how to create inroads where none appear to exist.

  • Can understand the customer’s business model, and how digital assets fit into their strategy

  • Have the ability to analyse data to identify market trends and opportunities for cryptocurrency and compliance

  • Can evaluate customer needs and preferences in relation to pricing, product terms and conditions to ensure that client requirements are addressed in commercial proposals

  • Enjoy working with pace and energy, building team spirit and cultivating unity and commitment among the team

  • Have an understanding of complex B2B sales methodologies

  • Are a self-starter, adaptable and comfortable with changing priorities

  • Proven experience and knowledge of use of AI tools into day-to-day workflows

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Strong outbound prospecting skills, with a track record of generating net new business and pipeline growth

  • Demonstrated track record of success and quota over achievement

  • A strong work ethic and an entrepreneur’s mindset. You’re comfortable creating value in a low structure environment while being agile and resilient

  • Minimum baseline understanding about digital assets and the crypto economy

  • Familiarity with the MEDDPPICC methodology and Value Based Selling.

  • Proficiency in CRM systems (HubSpot or similar), LLMs and other AI-driven prospecting and work efficiency tools.

  • Passionate about agentic AI and excited to help customers navigate a rapidly evolving industry.

Bonus Points for:

  • Intimate understanding of AML/KYC and Forensics space, either in cryptocurrency or traditional financial environments

jobs.description:
📍 London (Hybrid – 2 days in office, 3 days remote/WFH or office if you prefer!)

Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. At Goodlord, our mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting - simplifying complexity across agents, landlords and tenants.

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Brand to own how Goodlord shows up in the world - from our brand and content to PR, corporate affairs and thought leadership.

This is a role for someone who brings together brand ownership and PR/communications. You’ll have experience owning and shaping a B2B brand - its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market - alongside strong, hands-on PR and media experience.

You’ll have built that experience within B2B technology/SaaS, or in a PR and communications agency working with B2B technology clients. That combination is important: we need someone who is as comfortable thinking about our brand and positioning as they are shaping a story, working with journalists and building our reputation.

Reporting directly to our Marketing Director, you’ll lead a team of four across content, SEO and design, manage our external PR agency and work closely with colleagues across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales and the wider business.

You’ll help make Goodlord a distinctive and trusted voice in the industry, turning complex topics - from regulation and policy to AI and technology - into stories people actually want to read, hear and talk about.

If you like autonomy, pace and variety - and you’re comfortable being the person who both shapes what great looks like and helps make it happen - this could be a great fit!

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Owning our brand - shaping and evolving Goodlord’s positioning, messaging, identity and voice, and making sure we show up consistently and distinctively

  • Leading PR, media and corporate affairs - owning our day-to-day PR and media activity, building relationships with journalists, spotting and shaping stories, managing our external PR agency and leading our approach to regulatory, policy and reputation-related communications

  • Shaping our stories - turning complex industry, regulatory and technology topics into compelling narratives and thought leadership, working with senior leaders where needed

  • Leading content and SEO - setting the direction for our content and SEO specialists, helping them create useful, engaging work that supports our brand and wider business priorities

  • Leading creative and design - setting clear direction for our in-house designers and making sure everything we put into the world feels unmistakably Goodlord

  • Connecting brand to the business - partnering with Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales to make sure brand, PR and content support our wider commercial goals

ABOUT YOU

You’ll be well suited to this role if you:

  • Have strong commercial experience across brand and PR/communications, gained within B2B technology/SaaS or a PR and communications agency working with B2B technology clients, or a mix of both!

  • Have owned and shaped a brand - its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market - rather than solely delivering brand campaigns or driving brand awareness

  • Have strong, hands-on PR and media experience, with a track record of building journalist relationships, shaping stories and delivering earned coverage

  • Are a strong storyteller with sound strategic judgement, able to zoom out to brand strategy and zoom in to a single headline

  • Have experience across corporate affairs, reputation management and thought leadership, including working with senior leaders on external communications

  • Have experience directly leading and developing individual contributors, with the judgement to set direction across content, SEO and creative

  • Are commercially minded, collaborative and enjoy having ownership while staying close to the work

This role is about owning delivery, not building a large function. If you’re looking for a purely strategic communications role with a sizeable team underneath you, this probably isn’t the right fit. If you enjoy being close to the work and making things happen, we’d love to hear from you!

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Finom is building a brand that European entrepreneurs recognise and trust, and right now the visual side of that brand needs an owner.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will direct and mentor, and you will also design, setting the visual benchmark yourself, not just reviewing other people's work against it. You will work in close partnership with our VP of Product Design, so that the brand reads as one across marketing, product, and the entire brand experience.

Finom is building an AI-native production pipeline, and we want a creative leader who is already fluent in it. Not someone curious about AI, someone who has shipped with it and can design the workflows, quality gates and brand guardrails that make AI output genuinely good rather than merely fast.

•  Act as guardian of the visual identity while continuously pushing where the brand can be braver

  • Work with Commercial on ranges and promotions, with Finance to reconcile the plan to budget and working capital, and with Goods In and Warehouse Operations to keep inbound deliveries manageable
  • Build the team's capability, succession and reporting so the function spots problems early and doesn't have to rush orders through after the fact

  • Senior supply chain leadership experience, including direct ownership of S&OP, demand and supply planning, purchasing and inventory in a business with a large, varied product range
  • Deep practical knowledge of forecast accuracy and bias, inventory segmentation, safety stock, reorder logic, supplier lead times, service levels and working capital

Program ownership

  • Partner with engineering, product, IT, People, and Legal to embed security and compliance requirements into existing workflows rather than bolting them on afterward

  • Track regulatory and customer-driven compliance requirements — new customer security questionnaires, evolving frameworks — and translate them into practical, actionable controls

Reporting

Qualities we look for

  • 3-5 years of experience in information security, GRC, or compliance roles, ideally at a SaaS company, and ideally at scaleup pace and scale

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs and audits, from control design through evidence collection to certification

  • Experience with HIPAA and/or BSI C5 is a strong plus

  • Practical experience with GRC/evidence automation tooling such as Vanta (or equivalent), including building smooth, low-friction processes around it

  • A track record of building processes that shift evidence ownership to the teams generating the evidence, rather than centralizing it all in compliance

  • Sound risk judgment: comfortable making calculated, defensible risk decisions to keep product teams unblocked, rather than reflexively blocking

  • Strong stakeholder management skills; able to work credibly with engineers, product managers, and leadership without becoming an obstacle

  • Fluent English and German language skills at C1 level (or close by) are required

  • Clear, structured communicator who can translate compliance requirements into language engineering and product teams actually act on

With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. jobs.title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.

This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.

How we're set up

Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.

We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves.

What you'll own

  • Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible.

  • The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours.

  • Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.

  • A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.

  • Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad.

  • Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth.

  • Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it.

How we expect leaders to operate

  • Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems.

  • Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line.

  • End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally.

  • No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it.

  • Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against.

  • Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions.

Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too.

What you bring

  • 4 to 6+ years in engineering management, with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers.

  • A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical.

  • Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why.

  • Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully.

  • Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery.

  • Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it.

  • Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices: code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing.

Strong pluses

  • Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build.

  • Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation.

  • Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it.

What this role is, and isn't

It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).
